purpose: Recover bounded original least-cost route certificates before attaching any warehouse. Original caches contain costs/owners but no predecessor chains;do not infer ports from endpoints. This is route provenance,not a new food/store scenario or historical validation.
input_gate: Pin existing1981–2010 transport inputs,original road/strait/biome/cell-size/density recipe and city-node IDs. The prepared transport snapshot omits road,biome and cell_km;resolve them from the original already-qualified sources/recipe,not guessed defaults or the1991–2020 reader fallback. No new climate generation/fitting or wind source search. Verify all old source/protected hashes. Preserve failed restoration/identity attempts.
selection_before_routes: Use ORIGINAL5%/365monthly baseline,central and low. For each original quarter(0/3/6/9),select exactly one positive source→owner pair by largest recorded departures summed over that quarter,tie lowest physical source grid ID. Also select one intertown pair per quarter by largest recorded sent amount summed over that quarter,tie sender then receiver physical grid ID. Require existing positive-retention links;record an empty group without replacement if absent. Freeze selection.json before any graph/Dijkstra call. At most16route records total;no outcome-based substitutions or additional route/port searches.
graph_controls: Rebuild original legacy T.cost_network/C.Network semantics at only the four original snapshots,using original city/river/port recipe and direction. Reuse a graph across readings only if every graph-driving input and endpoint ordering are identical. Do not substitute FreightNetwork's alternative-selection semantics for legacy CSR duplicate summation. Recompute original reverse multi-city source distances/owners and require saved owner arrays and distances cast to their archived dtype EXACT before path interpretation. For chosen intertown pairs require distance cast to saved dtype EXACT. No new full all-pairs table.
paths: Retain predecessor node chains and directed CSR edge costs for selected pairs. Source paths follow the original reverse-graph convention;intertown paths follow the original forward convention. Require no cycles,valid physical/auxiliary/virtual IDs,correct endpoint owner and cost sum matching replayed distance at existing path tolerances. Decode river auxiliary physical cells and explicitly marked harbour/river-transfer membership only when provenance is available. An equal-cost representative is not proof of an unrecorded unique original path;retain ties/ambiguity and never choose a path because it crosses a desired warehouse.
duration_and_loss_limits: Do not infer physical days or unique transport mode from road-km cost. Record parallel-edge/mode ambiguity instead of selecting a more convenient leg. Do not alter retention or one-bin arrival assumptions. A later no-hold pass-through contract must preserve original whole-leg grain charge and arrival timing before introducing storage:product subleg retention differs by+a*b/L^2from one-leg retention,and adding a default-bin leg changes timing. This stage performs no grain dispatch or stock solve.
deliverable: Frozen selection,input-restoration identity receipts,at-most16cost/node/port-provenance route certificates and independent direction/edge/cost checks.
